# ML Infrastructure Architecture Dataset

## Overview
This dataset describes a complete machine learning infrastructure architecture as a directed graph of system components (nodes) and data/control flows (edges). It covers the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion through model serving and operational monitoring, including cross-cutting concerns like data lineage and version control.

## Data Source

### ml_architecture
A graph structure with two arrays: `nodes` and `edges`.

**Nodes** (9 total):
- `id` (string): unique identifier for the component
- `label` (string): display name, may include sub-labels for technology stack
- `layer` (string): architectural layer — one of data, compute, serving, observability, cross-cutting
- `sub_components` (array of strings): specific technologies or sub-systems within the node
- `criticality` (integer, 1–10): operational criticality score
- `category` (string): visual grouping category — data-layer, compute-layer, serving-layer, observability-layer

**Edges** (15 total):
- `source` / `target` (string): node IDs
- `flow_type` (string): one of primary, feedback, lineage
- `throughput_gbps` (float): data throughput in gigabits per second, range 0.1–12.5
- `label` (string): short description of what flows along the edge

## Data Notes
- Throughput values are representative estimates for a mid-scale ML platform
- Criticality scores are subjective team assessments
- The graph contains cycles via feedback edges (monitoring → data platform, monitoring → training cluster)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np

# --- Data ---
nodes = [
    {"id": "data_platform", "label": "Data Platform\n(Spark / Flink)", "layer": "data", "criticality": 9, "category": "data-layer"},
    {"id": "feature_store", "label": "Feature Store", "layer": "data", "criticality": 8, "category": "data-layer"},
    {"id": "training_cluster", "label": "Training Cluster\n(GPU)", "layer": "compute", "criticality": 10, "category": "compute-layer"},
    {"id": "model_registry", "label": "Model Registry", "layer": "compute", "criticality": 8, "category": "compute-layer"},
    {"id": "inference_online", "label": "Inference Service\n(Online / Real-time)", "layer": "serving", "criticality": 9, "category": "serving-layer"},
    {"id": "inference_offline", "label": "Inference Service\n(Offline / Batch)", "layer": "serving", "criticality": 7, "category": "serving-layer"},
    {"id": "ab_experiment", "label": "A/B Experiment\nPlatform", "layer": "serving", "criticality": 8, "category": "serving-layer"},
    {"id": "monitoring", "label": "Monitoring &\nAlerting", "layer": "observability", "criticality": 9, "category": "observability-layer"},
    {"id": "version_control", "label": "Version Control\n& Data Lineage", "layer": "cross-cutting", "criticality": 7, "category": "observability-layer"},
]

edges = [
    {"source": "data_platform", "target": "feature_store", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 12.5, "label": "Raw → Features"},
    {"source": "feature_store", "target": "training_cluster", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 8.0, "label": "Training Data"},
    {"source": "training_cluster", "target": "model_registry", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 2.5, "label": "Trained Models"},
    {"source": "model_registry", "target": "inference_online", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 1.8, "label": "Model Deploy (Online)"},
    {"source": "model_registry", "target": "inference_offline", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 3.2, "label": "Model Deploy (Batch)"},
    {"source": "inference_online", "target": "ab_experiment", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 5.0, "label": "Predictions (RT)"},
    {"source": "inference_offline", "target": "ab_experiment", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 4.0, "label": "Predictions (Batch)"},
    {"source": "ab_experiment", "target": "monitoring", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 2.0, "label": "Metrics & Results"},
    {"source": "monitoring", "target": "data_platform", "flow_type": "feedback", "throughput_gbps": 0.5, "label": "Data Quality Alerts"},
    {"source": "monitoring", "target": "training_cluster", "flow_type": "feedback", "throughput_gbps": 0.3, "label": "Retrain Trigger"},
    {"source": "version_control", "target": "feature_store", "flow_type": "lineage", "throughput_gbps": 0.1, "label": "Feature Versioning"},
    {"source": "version_control", "target": "training_cluster", "flow_type": "lineage", "throughput_gbps": 0.1, "label": "Experiment Tracking"},
    {"source": "version_control", "target": "model_registry", "flow_type": "lineage", "throughput_gbps": 0.1, "label": "Model Lineage"},
    {"source": "data_platform", "target": "version_control", "flow_type": "lineage", "throughput_gbps": 0.2, "label": "Data Lineage"},
    {"source": "feature_store", "target": "inference_online", "flow_type": "primary", "throughput_gbps": 6.0, "label": "Online Features"},
]

# --- Layout: custom positions for clear pipeline flow ---
pos = {
    "data_platform":     (0.0, 0.0),
    "feature_store":     (2.0, 0.0),
    "training_cluster":  (4.0, 0.0),
    "model_registry":    (6.0, 0.0),
    "inference_online":  (8.0, 1.2),
    "inference_offline": (8.0, -1.2),
    "ab_experiment":     (10.0, 0.0),
    "monitoring":        (12.0, 0.0),
    "version_control":   (3.0, -3.0),
}

# --- Color scheme (dark theme) ---
layer_colors = {
    "data-layer":        "#4A90D9",
    "compute-layer":     "#50C878",
    "serving-layer":     "#F5A623",
    "observability-layer": "#E74C3C",
}

flow_colors = {
    "primary":  "#C0C0C0",
    "feedback": "#FF6B6B",
    "lineage":  "#9B59B6",
}

# --- Build graph ---
G = nx.DiGraph()
for n in nodes:
    G.add_node(n["id"], **n)

# --- Figure setup ---
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(22, 11))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#1A1A2E')
ax.set_facecolor('#1A1A2E')

# --- Draw edges by type for layering ---
def throughput_to_width(t):
    return 0.8 + (t / 12.5) * 4.5

# 1) Lineage edges (draw first, behind everything)
lineage_edges = [(e["source"], e["target"]) for e in edges if e["flow_type"] == "lineage"]
lineage_widths = [throughput_to_width(e["throughput_gbps"]) for e in edges if e["flow_type"] == "lineage"]
nx.draw_networkx_edges(
    G, pos, edgelist=lineage_edges,
    width=lineage_widths, alpha=0.45,
    edge_color="#9B59B6",
    style="dashed",
    arrowstyle="-|>",
    arrowsize=18,
    connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.15",
    ax=ax,
)

# 2) Feedback edges (curved, red)
feedback_edges = [(e["source"], e["target"]) for e in edges if e["flow_type"] == "feedback"]
feedback_widths = [throughput_to_width(e["throughput_gbps"]) for e in edges if e["flow_type"] == "feedback"]
feedback_rad = ["arc3,rad=-0.3", "arc3,rad=-0.35"]
nx.draw_networkx_edges(
    G, pos, edgelist=feedback_edges,
    width=feedback_widths, alpha=0.7,
    edge_color="#FF6B6B",
    style="dashed",
    arrowstyle="-|>",
    arrowsize=20,
    connectionstyle=[r for r in feedback_rad],
    ax=ax,
)

# 3) Primary edges (on top)
primary_edges = [(e["source"], e["target"]) for e in edges if e["flow_type"] == "primary"]
primary_widths = [throughput_to_width(e["throughput_gbps"]) for e in edges if e["flow_type"] == "primary"]
# Custom connection styles for branching edges
primary_rad = []
for e in edges:
    if e["flow_type"] != "primary":
        continue
    s, t = e["source"], e["target"]
    if s == "model_registry" and t == "inference_online":
        primary_rad.append("arc3,rad=0.15")
    elif s == "model_registry" and t == "inference_offline":
        primary_rad.append("arc3,rad=-0.15")
    elif s == "inference_online" and t == "ab_experiment":
        primary_rad.append("arc3,rad=-0.15")
    elif s == "inference_offline" and t == "ab_experiment":
        primary_rad.append("arc3,rad=0.15")
    elif s == "feature_store" and t == "inference_online":
        primary_rad.append("arc3,rad=0.3")
    else:
        primary_rad.append("arc3,rad=0.0")

nx.draw_networkx_edges(
    G, pos, edgelist=primary_edges,
    width=primary_widths, alpha=0.85,
    edge_color="#C0C0C0",
    style="solid",
    arrowstyle="-|>",
    arrowsize=22,
    connectionstyle=primary_rad,
    ax=ax,
)

# --- Draw nodes ---
for n in nodes:
    x, y = pos[n["id"]]
    color = layer_colors[n["category"]]
    size = 800 + n["criticality"] * 250
    # Draw node circle with glow
    circle_glow = plt.Circle((x, y), 0.65, color=color, alpha=0.15, zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(circle_glow)
    circle = plt.Circle((x, y), 0.5, facecolor=color, edgecolor='white',
                         linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.9, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    # Criticality badge
    ax.text(x + 0.38, y + 0.38, str(n["criticality"]),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='white',
            ha='center', va='center', zorder=6,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='#333355', edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8))

# --- Draw node labels ---
for n in nodes:
    x, y = pos[n["id"]]
    ax.text(x, y - 0.7, n["label"],
            fontsize=9, color='white', ha='center', va='top',
            fontweight='bold', zorder=7,
            linespacing=1.1)

# --- Draw edge labels ---
edge_label_data = {}
for e in edges:
    if e["flow_type"] == "primary":
        edge_label_data[(e["source"], e["target"])] = f"{e['label']}\n{e['throughput_gbps']} Gbps"

for (s, t), lbl in edge_label_data.items():
    x1, y1 = pos[s]
    x2, y2 = pos[t]
    mx, my = (x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2
    # Offset labels slightly based on direction
    dy = y2 - y1
    dx = x2 - x1
    offset_y = 0.25 if dy >= 0 else -0.25
    if abs(dy) < 0.1:  # horizontal edge
        offset_y = 0.25
    ax.text(mx, my + offset_y, lbl,
            fontsize=7, color='#B0B0B0', ha='center', va='center',
            fontstyle='italic', zorder=8,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='#1A1A2E', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.8))

# --- Title ---
ax.set_title("ML Infrastructure Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline Flow",
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color='white', pad=20)

# --- Legend ---
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=layer_colors["data-layer"], edgecolor='white', label='Data Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=layer_colors["compute-layer"], edgecolor='white', label='Compute Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=layer_colors["serving-layer"], edgecolor='white', label='Serving Layer'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=layer_colors["observability-layer"], edgecolor='white', label='Observability / Cross-cutting'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color="#C0C0C0", linewidth=2.5, label='Primary Data Flow'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color="#FF6B6B", linewidth=2, linestyle='dashed', label='Feedback Loop'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color="#9B59B6", linewidth=1.5, linestyle='dashed', label='Lineage / Version Control'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='#1A1A2E', markerfacecolor='gray', markersize=8,
               label='Node size ∝ Criticality (1–10)'),
]
legend = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower left', fontsize=9,

legend.get_frame().set_linewidth(1.5)

# --- Pipeline stage labels at top ---
